source_review_notes: Primary activity evidence is figure/results based rather than MIC/MBC table based.
The DOCX supplement contains supplementary figures and a sequence-homology table, not antimicrobial activity or toxicity tables.
No graph-derived exact AUC/CFU values were created; raw values preserve the paper-supported qualitative/statistical outcomes.
